items.title: Hackers Hide Linux Backdoor in Control Web Panel Server to Execute Commands Without Logs
items.excerpt: A backdoor has been found hiding in the web server that runs Control Web Panel (CWP), a free panel for managing Linux hosting servers, researchers at QiAnXin's XLab said this week. The backdoored web server executes commands that attackers send via web requests, and those requests never appear in its access logs. Installing it takes root access, so the attackers must already control the server.

items.title: Google Issues Patches for Critical Android Flaw That Could Allow RCE Without User Interaction
items.excerpt: A critical Android flaw could allow an attacker to run code on a phone without any user action remotely, Google said in its November security bulletin.
